rationale: S-effort data-loss class with a live field trigger (their evict-conflicted pipeline produces marker files that delete rows at 2.16.0); main carries no other unreleased code; the validator is the one deliverable the field can wire into their drain immediately. Cost stated honestly: a point release IS a plugin change by construction (npm version rebuilds the bundle; CI requires both version files), and no 2.x point precedent exists — v1.21.1/v1.24.1 are the precedents. All three design lenses placed it in W2; the judge overrode on the vehicle rule and the maintainer critic corrected the cost.
